name: Fade In
description: Gradually fade opacity from 0% to 100%.

name: Pop In
description: Scale up with a bouncing animation.

name: Slide In
description: Slide into view horizontally.

name: Rise Up
description: Slide up into view from below.

name: Fade Out
description: Gradually fade opacity from 100% to 0%.

name: Zoom Out Exit
description: Slight scale pop, then zoom out to nothing.

name: Spin
description: Rotate 360 degrees around the anchor point.

name: Pulse
description: Gently grow and shrink in scale.

name: Shake
description: Rapid rotation oscillations for emphasis.

name: Elastic Float
description: Continuous smooth vertical floating movement.

name: Flip In 3D
description: Smooth entry flip around the 3D Y-axis.

name: Swing In 3D
description: Pendulum-like swing from the top axis.

name: Depth Push In
description: Push forward from deep Z space.

name: 3D Twirl In
description: Spin X and Y axes while scaling up into view.

name: Cinematic Pan 3D
description: Gentle 3D parallax rotation and depth panning.

name: Typewriter
description: Characters land one at a time with a hard edge, left to right.

name: Cascade
description: A long soft stagger — characters rise, untwist and settle in a flowing band.

name: Decode
description: Characters scramble through their own alphabet, then resolve.

name: Focus Pull
description: Text resolves out of defocus. No movement at all — only blur and fill.

name: Word Rise
description: Whole words lift into place — calmer than per-character on long lines.

name: Scatter In
description: Characters assemble in a shuffled order, not left to right.

name: Spring In
description: Each character overshoots and settles on its own damped spring.

name: Type Out
description: The typewriter in reverse — characters delete left to right.

name: Dissolve Out
description: Characters defocus and fade away in a soft travelling band.

name: Fall Away
description: Characters tip over and drop out of frame under gravity.

name: Converge Out
description: Letter spacing collapses inward until the word folds into itself.

name: Wave
description: A smooth vertical wave travels through the line and leaves it as it was.

name: Colour Sweep
description: A colour highlight glides across the text.

name: Spotlight
description: Everything dims except a travelling window — built by subtracting one selector from another.

name: Flicker
description: Characters flicker in a scrambled order, like a failing sign.

name: Jitter
description: Continuous uncorrelated per-character noise — reads as static.

name: Sway
description: Slow correlated drift — neighbouring characters move together, like cloth.

name: Inch Worm
description: A compression wave crawls along the line, squeezing tracking as it goes.

name: Fade In+Out
description: Fades up at the start and down at the end, sized to the composition — retime the comp and it still fits.

name: Auto-Scroll
description: Travels at a constant speed forever — for credits, tickers and marquees.

name: Drift
description: Slow continuous wander on both axes. Seeded, so it replays identically every time.

name: Pendulum
description: Endless pendulum rotation, like something hanging in a draught.

name: Orbit
description: Circles a point on a parametric path — no keyframes, no drift over time.

name: Audio Throb
description: Scales with the live audio level. Impossible to keyframe — it depends on the soundtrack.

name: Wipe In
description: A hard-edged wipe reveals the layer left to right.

name: Wipe Out
description: A hard-edged wipe clears the layer left to right.

name: Soft Wipe In
description: A wide feathered edge sweeps the layer in — a gradient wipe, not a hard line.

name: Diagonal Wipe Out
description: A feathered edge clears the layer on the diagonal.

name: Dissolve In
description: Resolves out of noise rather than simply fading — grain thins as opacity rises.

name: Blur Dissolve Out
description: Defocuses into nothing — the layer leaves by losing definition, not by sliding.

name: Gradient Drift
description: A two-colour ramp whose angle rotates slowly. Apply to a solid.

name: Aurora
description: Four colours bleeding into each other, breathing. Apply to a solid.

name: Drifting Noise
description: Slow organic fractal texture — a film-grain-ish bed rather than a flat colour.

name: Teal & Orange
description: The blockbuster grade — cool shadows, warm skin, gentle corner falloff.

name: Bleach Bypass
description: Silver-retention look — crushed contrast, drained colour, hot highlights.

name: Faded Film
description: Lifted blacks and milky highlights — the look of a print left in the sun.

name: Night Grade
description: Day-for-night — cool, dim, contrast pulled into the shadows.

name: Cross Process
description: C-41 in E-6 chemistry — hue-twisted midtones and a hard contrast curve.

name: Selective Colour Pop
description: One hue stays saturated, everything else goes monochrome.

name: Anamorphic Bokeh
description: Shallow depth with a bladed iris — highlights bloom into hexagons.

name: Clean Skin
description: Edge-preserving smoothing — texture goes, features stay sharp.

name: Restore Old Footage
description: Removes specks and scratches, then re-levels the contrast.

name: Comic Book
description: Flat cel shading with inked edges over a rotated dot screen.

name: Newsprint
description: Coarse black-and-white halftone on off-white paper.

name: Oil Painting
description: Directional brushwork with the palette flattened behind it.

name: Kaleidoscope Mandala
description: Eight mirrored wedges, slowly rotating.

name: Chromatic Lens
description: Barrel distortion with a bladed defocus — a cheap-glass look.

name: Broadcast Interference
description: Rolling-shutter skew and torn coverage — a signal losing lock.

name: Iris In
description: A circular aperture opens from the centre.

name: Hex Iris Out
description: A six-sided aperture closes the frame down.

name: Light Wipe In
description: A glowing edge sweeps across and leaves the layer behind it.

name: Grid Dissolve Out
description: The frame breaks into tiles that open from their own centres.

name: Line Sweep Out
description: Parallel lines clear in sequence — a travelling comb.

name: Burn Away
description: The frame chars and blows out from a point, like film in the gate.

name: Page Turn Out
description: The layer peels back over a curl and lifts away.

name: Ripple Through
description: A shock ring crosses the frame and settles.

name: Split Apart
description: The frame cuts in two and the halves separate.

name: Radial Light Burst
description: Rays fan out from the centre and fade — a flash cut that is not just white.

name: Falling Snow
description: Soft snowfall drifting across the frame, ready-wound for six seconds.

name: Driving Rain
description: Streaking rain with drops rippling the picture beneath it.

name: Star Voyage
description: The layer scattered into a starfield being flown through.

name: Dream Glass
description: The frame refracted through its own relief — soft, expensive, slightly wet.

name: Retro Chromatic
description: Edge fringing, grain and a corner shade — the worn-lens music-video look.

name: Shatter Away
description: The frame breaks into shards that fly, tumble and fade.

name: Jaws Bite
description: The picture bitten in two along a toothed seam.

name: Wring Out
description: The frame wrings itself edge-on around its own middle and vanishes.

name: Card Cascade
description: The frame lifts into dancing cards and settles back — a hit, not a cut.

name: Push In
description: Slow dolly toward the scene — a quarter of the way in, eased.

name: Pull Out
description: The reveal — dolly back away from the scene.

name: Orbit Sweep
description: A gentle arc around the point of interest, with a slight rise.

name: Drift Parallax
description: Small lateral drift with a slight push — the move that shows layer depth.

name: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo)
description: Dolly in while the lens zooms out — framing holds, the background falls away.

name: Handheld
description: Subtle operator wobble — pan, tilt and a breath of dolly, baked as keyframes.
